name: Blinker
description: Lives in optical implants and causes brief visual artifacts — flashes, color shifts, phantom shapes at the edge of vision.
observed_behavior: Injects 0.1-0.5 second visual anomalies at irregular intervals. The artifacts are always the same shape for a given host but different between hosts.
story_hooks: A user realizes the phantom shapes they've been seeing match the floor plan of a building they've never entered
